title: From Superficial Outputs to Superficial Learning: Risks of Large Language Models in Education
benchmark_measurement: The influence of LLM-generated content on users' cognitive processing and shifts in attitudes towards various religious groups, specifically measuring changes in beliefs after exposure to AI-generated religious descriptions.
findings: Exposure to LLM-generated content caused a statistically significant shift in users' attitudes towards religions. Perceptions of Christianity and Judaism became more favourable, while perceptions of Islam declined, underscoring the potential of LLMs to subtly shape users' religious beliefs when content is consumed without critical scrutiny.
